home.description: Personal site of Alper Bayram — software engineer, writer, and builder. Notes on software, the web, and things I am learning.

paragraphs: I'm a software engineer. I've been actively involved in software development processes for 4+ years. My career has largely been shaped within startup culture. I began my first professional experience at a startup, and in the years that followed I took on roles in full-stack software development, product development, and the management of technical processes across different startup projects. I'm currently working as a freelancer, providing full-stack software support to a startup.

I care not only about building software but also about being part of work that benefits people. I value social life, community work, and contributing as a volunteer. In my free time I'm into sports; I actively play tennis and do rowing. Doing sports outdoors, in particular, gives me energy.

contact.lead: If you need a new website, an e-commerce platform, a mobile app, or a custom software solution, feel free to get in touch with me.
